title: Maximal right ideals of the Banach algebra of bounded operators on a Banach space
summary: We study finitely generated maximal right ideals of the Banach algebra $\mathcal{B}(E)$ of bounded operators on a complex Banach space $E$. Every maximal right ideal is either fixed by a non-zero functional or contains the ideal of finite-rank operators; when $E$ is infinite-dimensional, each non-fixed maximal right ideal in fact contains the ideal of inessential operators.
